{{Quote|Approaching drop zone. Everyone stay tight.''"<br />"''Remember, you've only got one shot at this.''"<br />"''Bombs away.|Goji and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as the former releases the electro-proton bomb|<ref name="TZB" />}}
'''Goji''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who was the leader of [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He flew a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] marked with the colors of [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] at the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] leader<ref name="Hasbro" /> Goji and [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Rod/Legends|Rod]] were temporarily incorporated into the Republic forces on Malastare when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|invaded]]. Their [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] was loaded with a prototype weapon known as an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which was successfully released on target, creating a massive [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] that deactivated or destroyed all the droid forces gathered on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="TZB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
As a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Goji possessed innate skill and extensive training in delivering weapons, such as the electro-proton bomb, accurately to their targets.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
As with every [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], Goji was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. Hasbro released its 3-3/4" Goji action figure in 2010.<ref name="TZB" /><ref name="Hasbro" />

Goji's name and the markings on his helmet are a tribute to the Japanese name 'Gojira'(ゴジラ), known more commonly in English as [[Wikipedia:Godzilla|Godzilla]].<ref name="Gojira">{{SW|url=video/the-zillo-beast-episode-featurette|text="The Zillo Beast" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
